title: Annotatio IV §.I open: After frustrated peace attempts — inquire into OBICES; general vs special
pass_a_gloss: §. I. After so many frustrated Efforts of composing Ecclesiastical Peace, the Author not undeservedly inquires into the OBSTACLES opposed to attempts so pious, p. 341 and following — yet pointing only at the special ones, the more general ones from which those are derived having been passed over in silence, which it will meanwhile have been worthwhile at least to have mentioned in summary, chiefly to this end, that they may be more carefully guarded against.
pass_b_english: §. I. After so many frustrated attempts to compose church peace, the Author not without cause turns to the OBSTACLES set against such pious efforts (p. 341ff.).
He points only at the special ones, passing the more general sources in silence — yet it is worth at least summarizing those generals too, mainly so they may be more carefully guarded against.
source_text:
§. I.
Post tot Pacis Ecclesiasticae componendae molimina frustrata, non immeritò in OBICES, Conatibus tam piis oppositos, inquirit Autor P. 341. & seq. ad speciales tamen digitum solùmmodò intendens, generalioribus, ex quibus isti derivantur, silentio praetervectis, quos intereà & ipsos summarium saltem memorâsse è re fuerit, eum potissimum in finem, quò studiosius caveantur.
